input: Take a one-day cheese making workshop nearby

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's location or city determines which workshops are actually 'nearby' and searchable.
A target date or timeframe narrows down available sessions and affects urgency of booking.
Cheese making covers many styles (soft, hard, aged, mozzarella, etc.); knowing a preference focuses the search on relevant workshops.
Whether this is solo, with a partner, or a group changes booking logistics, seat count, and possibly the type of workshop (private vs. public).
Workshop prices vary widely ($50–$300+); a budget ceiling filters out options and affects decision-making.
Some workshops are purely hands-on, others lecture-based or include meals/tastings; knowing the preferred experience style helps prioritise options.
Understanding whether the goal is a fun experience, a practical skill to use at home, or a gift/activity for someone else shapes which workshop qualities matter most.
